briefing: The tree grub yield off {HERE} holds at full quota, but one export ledger canister never arrived. A smuggler has it, and the account will not close without it.
I am {PATRON}, governor of {HERE}. Recover the canister, confirm the Cobra that took it, then finish that Cobra.
Pay clears leg by leg, on delivery only. Treat this as a contract, not a favour.

ledger.arrive: Scoop the ledger canister adrift at {TARGET}.
ledger.success: The canister is aboard, and {PAY} is logged for {TARGET}.
ledger.fail: The ledger canister at {TARGET} is lost, and {PAY} is void.

witness.arrive: Hold the partner's Cobra at {TARGET} on your scanner.
witness.success: Twenty seconds held at {TARGET}, and {PAY} stands confirmed.
witness.fail: The Cobra slipped the scan at {TARGET}, and {PAY} is void.

runner.arrive: Destroy the smuggler's Cobra, last seen at {TARGET}.
runner.success: The Cobra is down near {TARGET}, and {PAY} is paid in full.
runner.fail: The trail at {TARGET} went cold, and {PAY} is void.

dossier.lead: {PATRON} left word at {WORLD}, asking the commander to check in.

rumour.far: Word from {WORLD} says {PATRON} is short one grub ledger, and none too patient about it.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the ledger is late, and the clock is running.

dossier.news: {WORLD} reports that {PATRON} is signing pilots for ledger recovery work.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander took a governor's contract to find a missing grub ledger.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, near {WORLD}, the smuggler's trail ended, and the ledger case closed.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, near {WORLD}, the ledger case went cold, and the smuggler got away clean.

ledger.success: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the commander scooped the ledger canister intact.
ledger.targetDestroyed: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the ledger canister broke apart before the commander could reach it.
ledger.failed: By day {DAY}, near {WORLD}, the ledger recovery ran past its deadline.

witness.success: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the commander held the smuggler's Cobra on the scanner for the full count.
witness.targetDestroyed: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, another gun destroyed the watched Cobra before the count ran out.
witness.targetEscaped: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the watched Cobra jumped clear before the count ran out.
witness.failed: By day {DAY}, near {WORLD}, the watch on the Cobra lapsed past its deadline.

runner.targetDestroyed: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the commander destroyed the smuggler's Cobra.
runner.targetEscaped: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the smuggler's Cobra jumped clear of the commander.
runner.targetFled: At {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the smuggler's Cobra fled the commander's guns.
runner.failed: By day {DAY}, near {WORLD}, the hunt for the smuggler's Cobra ran past its deadline.

dossier.title: The Grub Ledger
